title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF provided guidance and technical support for policies, programmes, advocacy and knowledge generation for the prevention of all forms of malnutrition among school-age children and adolescents. 77 countries were supported to prevent overweight and obesity and prevent anemia.UNICEF focused on introducing plans, programmes and use of innovative financing mechanisms to improve maternal nutrition. In 2024, 45 countries received support to scale -up maternal nutrition interventions. 37 of these countries have introduced Multiple Micronutrient Supplements (MMS) as part of the antenatal care package.
